audit_completeness_gaps.title: CONFIRMED inter-judge factual contradiction on the ledger census, used load-bearingly in opposite directions and never adjudicated. The novelty judge "verified exactly" 78 rows / 44 proven-tier / 9 measured (attacker's strongest point); the significance judge "verified on disk" 80 rows / 15 measured + 4 measured_diagnostic and used it to KILL the attacker's census as stale. I recounted docs/generated/egs_results_table_v9.json at HEAD: 78 rows; statuses: 18 proven_gate + 14 proven_symbolic + 6 proven_seal + 6 proven = 44 proven-tier (attacker exact); 9 measured, 3 measured_diagnostic, 5 measured_synth, 2 measured_partial, 1 measured_no_go. The significance judge's "15 measured" is reachable only by counting measured_synth (synthetic!) and measured_no_go as measured, and "80 rows"/"4 measured_diagnostic" match nothing on disk. Why it matters: a kill in the significance debate rests on a false verification, and the significance axis score (3) leans on that kill. Close: reverse the kill, restore attacker point 8, and have the significance judge restate the ruling against the true census (done above at zero cost; only the ruling text needs amending).

C1's kill-level systematic was never propagated to its downstream consumers — each lane audited in isolation. The radial-monopole/distance-error contamination that refuted C1 lives in the same catalog columns consumed by: C9's GLS 340.7±5.0 (no monopole-nulling test run on the GLS weights), C3's fσ8 (Vpec column; the correctness debate PRESCRIBES a "depth-cut robustness check against the C1 Vpec monopole contamination" but no lane executed it), Ω_tilt=4.07e-7, the CF4 rapidity containment rows quoted on C7/C8 theory surfaces, and C2's calibration target. The PRD referee flags "re-derive every data-lane number quoted on theory surfaces" as must-fix but the audit itself never ran the check. Close: rerun the C1 attack's existing monopole-projection diagnostic against the GLS weights and the fσ8 analysis cells, plus one Vpec depth-cut refit — the code already exists from the C1 attack; hours, not days.

Novelty digest never reconciled with the correctness outcomes it contradicts. Cluster 1 classifies |B|(200)=405 as CONFIRMATORY_REPRODUCTION of Watkins 2023 (within 0.4σ) while C1 refutes it as an artifact whose vector is ~540 km/s from Watkins — an artifact cannot be a reproduction. Cluster 2 calls fσ8=0.40 confirmatory of the 0.34–0.42 consensus, but with the refuted pk_corr removed the raw value is 0.486 — 4.9σ ABOVE published CF4 — i.e. discrepant, not confirmatory; the novelty verdict silently depends on the correction correctness killed. Why it matters: the referees' "every surviving lane is a reproduction" framing inherits these stale classifications. Close: re-issue cluster 1 and 2 verdicts conditioned on C1/C3 (cluster 1 → artifact/not-classifiable; cluster 2 → discrepant-pending-recalculation).

Claims with zero audit coverage, one of which "survived" only by omission. (a) The OMK-REOPEN slaving theorem κ=−1/(2+q) + six Ω_k ceilings: the novelty debate defender explicitly lists it as "unengaged by the attacker" and it is then counted as a surviving novel result — survival-by-omission, not survival. (b) The production-physics anchor (D_2=1002.086744, x_C bit-identity machinery) that every "frozen/bit-identical" assertion leans on. (c) EGS2 lanes (NT2-A1 Fisher-CR floor etc.), the Teff representative lane, and the K1 BipoSH lane's NOVELTY (C10 audited its correctness only; no novelty cluster positions BipoSH SI against the Hajian–Souradeep lineage, nor the JWST crossmatch). (d) The v9 reproducibility-package hash claims (74/74 verify in-zip). Close: one supplemental correctness lane for OMK (dual-engine scripts exist; replication is hours), a novelty mini-cluster for K1-BipoSH/JWST, and an explicit out-of-scope register for the rest so absence of findings is not read as clearance.

The corpus's sole "NEW" pillar rests on a single unattacked search. The partial-identification/Imbens–Manski transfer was adjudicated NEW by ONE novelty lane's null prior-art search, then propagated unchallenged into all three referee reports and both debate rulings as "the actual contribution" and the anchor of every restructure recommendation. Every data claim got a kill-configured adversary; the novelty pillar got none. Close: one targeted adversarial prior-art search (partial identification / set identification / Manski bounds in astrophysics: GW population & EOS inference, cluster mass calibration, deconvolution/unfolding literature) before any restructure decision is finalized.

Corrections asserted inside correctness lanes but never executed — they currently have the same epistemic status as the errors they correct: (a) C2 "empirical floor likely survives rescaling (~0.1/2000 expected exceedances)" — never rerun with the fixed generator + pk_corr; (b) C4's corrected p≈0.69 comes from a 60-mock proxy-footprint experiment, not the full 400-mock real-footprint recalibration the fix demands — yet three referees quote 0.69 as the corrected value; (c) C5's "anti-conservative by a factor of a few" is an order-fsky guess; the mask/reconstruction transfer was never computed; (d) C10's 14-anchor forecast was back-solved, not rerun. Close: each is a bounded rerun of code that already exists (the audit's own scripts or the repo's); quote them as estimates until run.

Unadjudicated novelty-vs-correctness contradiction on the ACT mean-field step: novelty cluster 4 credits "mean-field-debiasing of low-L kappa alm as the enabling method" (verdict ALREADY_KNOWN, but treated as a real methodological step), while C5 finds the in-house MF subtraction a numerical no-op (release product already debiased upstream). Both cannot stand; the card's methodology label depends on which is right. Close: adopt C5's evidenced position (it cites the release provenance), amend the novelty cluster and the card label in one pass.

Degenerate novelty verdict: cluster 4 awards "NEW" to "interpretive claim scope: no anisotropy/family/geometry claim" — a non-claim scored as a novel contribution, inflating the NEW count that downstream surfaces cite. Close: reclassify as a scope note, not a verdict.

Debate-vs-panel score divergence is only half-explained. The rulings implicitly score the post-concession reshaped corpus while the referees score as-shipped, but this is never stated as a rule, and two conflicts are flat-out unexplained: (a) unanimous panel significance = 2 vs debate significance = 3; (b) the skeptic referee explicitly rules "'major revisions' would misrepresent the situation" (reject-resubmit) while the correctness judge lands on the major-revisions-equivalent 3 even as the judge's own text says "not publishable as shipped... would not survive first-round referee scrutiny." The uniform 3/3/3 pattern also suggests central-tendency compression. Close: a one-paragraph meta-adjudication fixing the scored object (as-shipped vs post-surgery) and restating each axis score under both objects.

No test-adequacy/gate-coverage lane exists, though it is the most load-bearing missing check. Every kill-level defect (monopole leak, Hermitian-plane GRF bug, mislabeled nonlinear σ_v, misattributed synthetic forecast number, SG-units bug) passed the corpus's hundreds of gates, and the skeptic referee's sharpest structural charge ("blind at the estimator-systematics layer") is asserted by all lanes but analyzed by none. rev-r197's shipped-failing test is prior evidence. Close: map the ~6 confirmed P0/P1 mechanisms onto the existing gate files (grep-level) and record which gate CLASS would have caught each — a cheap taxonomy that turns the charge into an actionable fix.

Concrete-but-unenumerated artifacts block the must-fixes: "three stale manuscript sites (one unregistered)" (C7), the un-marked refuted triples in bounds.py and egs3_parent_identity.py (C7/C8/debate), and the rev-r195 card's false '~10%' caveat (C9) are repeated by every referee, but no lane shipped the file:line list — the fix cannot be executed or verified without it. Close: grep the manuscript and live modules for the refuted triple coefficients and the old W2_max value; attach the site list to the findings.

Asymmetric rigor on the audit's own replacement result: C1's monopole-nulled re-estimate (94.8±73.7 km/s) is validated algebraically (G^T w = I to 2e-16) but never by injection — no mock with a TRUE ~400 km/s flow plus realistic distance errors was passed through the constrained weights to confirm recovery and the quoted variance. The audit demands exactly this injection standard of the corpus (C2). Since the referees now quote 94.8±73.7 as the corrected truth, it deserves the same treatment. Close: push the existing C2 mock ensemble through the monopole-nulled weights; both code halves already exist.

The audit never states its own coverage boundary. Blocked lanes (K1 FFP10 E2E, COLA nonlinear mocks, ACT N0/N1-on-QE, native solver) were correctly not audited, but nowhere is "not examined" distinguished from "examined, no findings" — and 78 ledger rows map to only 10 correctness claims + 6 novelty clusters with no coverage table. Close: one table mapping ledger rows → audit lane (C1–C10 / cluster 1–6 / none), which also mechanically surfaces item 4's uncovered rows.

Referee "panel" unanimity is derivative, not independent: all three reports visibly consume the same two digests (identical numbers, identical citation lists, near-identical must-fix sets), so three-way agreement adds no confirmation weight beyond the digests themselves — yet the composite reads as independent convergence. Close: disclose the dependency; if independent confirmation is wanted, rerun one referee role digest-blind on a sampled claim (C4 or C6 are cheapest, both have self-contained cards).
